text:
alex: Quick check — need a short status + owners for console observability milestones. Dashboards v2, trace hook rollout, error-analysis views, and retention cutover. Planning a lightweight sync Tue 10am if we can lock owners.

maria: I can take dashboards v2. PR 452 is open, needs design review and one more eng review. pinging @sam for perf review. :eyes:

sam: Thanks @maria — will review PR452 today. I also volunteer to own trace-hook rollout if infra enables the sampling flag and the staging canary. I filed INF-789 for the flag.

jin: I'll take retention cutover ownership but I need approval for the storage bump (estimate +18% cost). Created TKT-1201 with numbers. Also need clarity on retention time boundary: is it 30d->90d or staged 30->60->90?

priya: For error-analysis views I can drive the query surfaces and UX. Question: do we want per-route error histograms or keep it service-level first? I vote per-route for ramping, will add toggle.

ken: Quick dependency note — rate-limiter changes from eng-infra (PR 900) will affect dashboard live tile latency around midnight jobs. eng-infra owners: @ops-bot pls confirm ETA.

ops-bot: eng-infra PR900 merged to staging. Scheduled deploy: 2025-11-03T02:30Z. No expected downtime. :white_check_mark:

sam: deploy-bot — canary for trace-hook-rollout started on staging. Observability alert channel is #staging-canaries.

deploy-bot: Canary started: trace-hook-rollout-staging (canary_id=c-778). Monitoring hooks: traces-per-sec, tail-latency, error-spike.

maria: design comment on PR452 posted. Also attaching a small CSS tweak that reduces render churn — should help perceived latency for tiles.

alex: Good. Action items so far:
- dashboards v2: owner @maria (PR452) — maria to get perf review from @sam by EOD Thu.
- trace hooks: owner @sam; infra ticket INF-789 must be closed before wide rollout. Canary running now, sam to report metrics by EOD Mon.
- retention cutover: owner @jin; jin to get storage approval from finance and ops, update TKT-1201 with final cost.
- error-analysis: owner @priya; priya to prototype per-route toggle and share example queries.

alex: Also please add brief checklist comments to each PR linking the relevant ticket and the expected rollout guardrails (canary thresholds, fallback plan). Example guard snippet to paste into PR body:

```
Canary thresholds:
- tail latency: +20%
- error-rate: +0.5% absolute
- token drop rate: 0
Fallback: automatic rollback to previous model variant and route traffic to legacy dashboard tiles.
```

sam: Will add the thresholds to the trace-hook PR and wire an automated rollback action.

jin: Noted — I'll add the storage numbers and a migration plan to TKT-1201. If finance signs off we can aim for phased cutover the week after next.

priya: I'll post a short mockup + sample queries in this thread by tomorrow.

alex: Perfect. If anyone else wants to jump in or swap ownership, call it out here. Otherwise I'll run the Tue 10am sync with these owners on the agenda. :calendar: 

ken: small ask — can we tag related console-alerts in the PRs so on-call knows to mute during canary?

maria: yes, will add alert tags.

sam: reporting back after canary run by 2025-11-03T18:00Z with metrics.

alex: Thanks everyone — closing the loop here. Short updates preferred in-thread, escalate offline for blockers. :lock:
